mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contracts c WHERE c.origin_contract_url LIKE CONCAT('%/', #{userId}, '/%') AND c.contract_status IN ('SIGNED', 'PAID')
SELECT COALESCE(total_earned, 0) FROM freelancer_wallets WHERE freelancer_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_applications WHERE freelancer_id = #{userId} AND application_status = 'PENDING'
SELECT COALESCE(balance, 0) FROM freelancer_wallets WHERE freelancer_id = #{userId}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(c.contracted_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(c.total_budget) AS totalAmount FROM contracts c JOIN project_applications pa ON c.contract_id = pa.application_id WHERE pa.freelancer_id = #{userId} AND c.total_budget IS NOT NULL AND c.contracted_at >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(c.contracted_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
SELECT contract_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM contracts WHERE origin_contract_url LIKE CONCAT('%/', #{userId}, '/%') GROUP BY contract_status

SELECT p.project_id, p.title, p.budget, p.est_duration AS estDuration, pa.application_status AS applicationStatus, pa.applied_at AS appliedAt FROM project_applications pa JOIN projects p ON pa.project_id = p.project_id WHERE pa.freelancer_id = #{userId} ORDER BY pa.applied_at DESC LIMIT 3
